text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...The sounds of the surface are 
'stable'... Different from 'Lyra'... but 
still 'alive'...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Inside Neo Universe, there is a 
"vibration"... The 『only』 sound audible, 
even in a "vacuum"...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Melodia...! Ah, Miss Universe. I wonder 
what kind of sounds are reaching your 
ears.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo! If there are sounds in this 
world that I do not know, I would love for 
you to teach me!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth... wants to "seek" the 
sounds Neo Universe is hearing?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And if possible, I'd love to 
dedicate a song to you, the one who showed 
me a brand new world!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Music... Neo Universe "understands". It is 
one form of "communication" for "humans".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Then, Neo Universe wants to do 
"seek" as well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A request? Certo! With pleasure! Tell me, 
what melody that graces heaven and earth 
do you desire?
